title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(山口敦史研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Yamaguchi Atsushi)
educationalGoal: Training will be carried out to grow up engineers in the electrical & electronic fields with problem-finding ability, solution ability, and application ability through educational programs that emphasize basic knowledge and skills in the fields of electrical engineering and electronic engineering, which are highly important in modern society
advice: This course is the final course of the project design course, including an introduction to project design, and is positioned as a course that integrates the items learned in all courses. Aim to review basic subjects and acquire advanced expertise through experiment and theoretical examination of project themes. Divide into teams for each project theme shown below and conduct research activities. Report research progress about once a week and discuss how to proceed. (1) Evaluation of physical properties of InGaN quantum wells (2) Physical property evaluation of GaN substrate (3) Evaluation of physical properties of oxide semiconductors (ZnO, etc.) (4) Physical property evaluation of InGaAs / InP semiconductors (5) Study of laser beam quality of laser scanners
requiredKnowledge: Review what you have learned in mathematics, semiconductor engineering, and electronic properties. English is also required to read academic papers. Metal processing skills (Yumekobo license) and computer programming skills are also desired.

activityGoals.body: To clarify the purpose of the project theme and make a research plan.
To consider a problem-solving method of the project theme and execute it safely and continuously.
To analyze and evaluate the research results correctly based on the social needs.
To discuss actively in group and make a presentation on research results effectively
To summarize the research results as project reports..

achievementLevels.ideal: The significance and purpose of the project theme are fully understood and research activities are actively promoted. The research contents and results can be explained to others in an easy-to-understand manner. The Achievement can be summarized in papers and/or be presented at academic conferences.
achievementLevels.standard: The significance and purpose of the project theme are understood, and the contents can be explained. The problems in the research can be pointed out. Application of research results in related fields can be proposed. Design and fabrication of the equipment necessary to carry out research on the project theme, can be done. Research results can be presented at the Project Design III Presentation Review and related academic societies’ meeting, and good discussion can be made in Q&A sessions. Research activities can be continued based on the research plan until the end of the project.
